content.title: LFUS Q3 Deep Dive: Basler Acquisition, Data Center Momentum, and Mixed Guidance
content.summary: Electronic component provider Littelfuse (NASDAQ:LFUS) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.1% year on year to $624.6 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $580 million was less impressive, coming in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.95 per share was 5.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
